issue_context.title: reuse memory when to (*HashAggExec).initPartialWorkers
issue_context.body: ## Enhancement it takes many time for (*HashAggExec).initPartialWorkers to allocate memory. so we should reuse it to avoid allocate it frequently. https://flamegraph.com/share/83a1cf7e-f157-11ee-9a90-6a1bdcb04d5a

review_comments:
> Why use `*[][]xx` instead of `[][]xx`

It's better to return pointer type in sync.Pool, [refer](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/54179128/is-it-necessary-to-return-pointer-type-in-sync-pool-new-function)
